name: Editorial publication
summary: A reading-first publication. Display type carries the issue; body copy stays quiet and long enough to read.

fidelity.notes: Costume on the masthead. Keep the essay and newsletter controls free of display faces.

required.purpose: Issue title, kicker, and primary navigation
Lead essay with byline and a readable measure

layouts: Full-bleed masthead, then a narrow measure for the essay.
Department stories sit in a wrapping grid, not a component gallery.

responsive.behavior: Stack the essay and side note. Let the nav wrap. Do not shrink body text below 1rem.

priorities: Display face on the masthead and story title only.
No display face on buttons, fields, or nav.

spacing.priority: Large space before the essay, tight space inside paragraphs, generous gap between departments.

interactions: Newsletter submit confirms locally and states that no list is contacted.
accessibility: Visible labels on the email field and consent checkbox.

use: Masthead hero hooks for the active era.
One ornament divider between the essay and departments.
avoid: A costume divider between every paragraph.

eraDeviations.note: Keep .ew-hero__stage in the masthead so costume sun, grid, starbursts, and arch can render. Cap stage height in page CSS so the essay starts on the first screen.
Wrap masthead copy in .ew-hero__panel with rays and fan. Do not rebuild the rest of the page.

customization: Publication name, issue, essay, departments, and the default era.
Swap era and band on the root without rewriting sections.
